config.prompt: Utiliza el agente weather_expert para verificar el clima actual en Madrid y determinar si necesito chaqueta.

weather_expert.description: Busca el tiempo o el clima de la localización utilizando APIs de meteorología.

phase_reactor.system_message: You are summarizing the results of a completed phase. Write a single sentence summary of what was accomplished. Set task_ok=true.

final_reactor.system_message: You are giving a final answer to the user based on the weather data collected. Synthesize the information and clearly answer whether the user needs a jacket. Be concise (2-3 sentences). Set task_ok=true.
